data:
Optional authoring helper for reusable steps over a typed context.
Definitions receive fresh execution state from the runner; do not capture live contexts in shared steps.
public class ScenarioSteps<TContext> where TContext : notnull
Lets a derived class group reusable steps over TContext.
Creates reusable setup or operation work for Given/When and their action And steps.
protected static ScenarioAction<TContext> CreateActionStep(string name, Action<TContext> execute, string? description = null)
Creates reusable asynchronous setup or operation work for Given/When and their action And steps.
protected static ScenarioAction<TContext> CreateActionStep(string name, Func<TContext, Task> execute, string? description = null)
Creates reusable asynchronous setup or operation work that takes the run's cancellation token, for Given/When and their action And steps.
protected static ScenarioAction<TContext> CreateActionStep(string name, Func<TContext, CancellationToken, Task> execute, string? description = null)
Func<TContext, CancellationToken, Task>

Creates operation work that returns a value. Checks after it take the value, typed: a Then lambda that takes a parameter of its type, or a step from CreateReturnedStep<TResult>(string, Action<TContext, TResult>, string?).
protected static ScenarioAction<TContext> CreateActionStep<TResult>(string name, Func<TContext, TResult> execute, string? description = null)
Creates asynchronous operation work that returns a value. Checks after it take the value, typed.

Creates asynchronous operation work that takes the run's cancellation token and returns a value. Checks after it take the value, typed.

Creates operation work that must throw exactly TException, as Assert.Throws checks. Anything else, or nothing, fails the step and stops the scenario. Steps from CreateThrownStep<TException>(string, Action<TContext, TException>, string?) then take the exception, typed.
